attributes.name: Pleaser
attributes.powers:
The Pleaser is immune to the Electricity, Fire, and Poison traits. Banish any allies played during this encounter; you may expend a mythic charge to ignore this for any ally.

If undefeated, the Pleaser deals no damage; instead, bury an ally, or if you have no allies, banish a random boon.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
